SELECT college, group_count, CAST(group_count AS REAL) / total_count, group_count - average_count
FROM (
  SELECT college, group_count, total_count,
         AVG(group_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM (
    SELECT college, COUNT(*) AS group_count,
           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_count
    FROM member
    JOIN major ON CAST(member.link_to_major AS BLOB) = CAST(major.major_id AS BLOB)
    GROUP BY college
  )
)
WHERE group_count > average_count
